sources.description: Regulator contact and current official resources

Reports licence fees, six-month transition and warranty minima
SI 126/2026 §§3–6, PDF pages 1–2, available in founder-supplied research upload; not distributed from this website

claims.statement: SI 187 of 2026 titled Energy Regulatory (Solar Products and Installation) Regulations was published on 20 November 2026
Six months after publication reported, giving a derived target around 20 May 2027; verify actual commencement
Reported minima: 10 years solar modules; 5 years lithium batteries and solar water heaters; 2 years inverters, charge controllers and home solar kits; 1 year lead-acid batteries
Reported solar technician licence tiers ST1 to ST4; exact eligibility and lawful work scope unverified
SI 126/2026 has an own-consumption preconstruction registration category from 100 kW through 10 MW and requires licensing above 10 MW; this does not exempt smaller plants from other rules
Model registration information may be checked via ZERA; a model-level match does not authenticate a particular physical unit
